steps: Complete OTR (One Time Registration) on NSP yourself. It is Aadhaar based, so Lookout does not touch it.
Log in with your OTR ID and choose "PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme Of Top Class Education In College For OBC, EBC And DNT Students".
Fill the fields below and upload the documents.
Submit before 31 Oct 2026.
Ask your institute to verify your application before 15 Nov 2026.
